title: Expanded Trade
description: A simple mod adding more offers to settlers.
body:
The purpose of this simple mod is to add more variety to trading with villagers. The mod adds more offers for villagers at both beginner and higher levels, also based on offers from the base version of the game. This mod only adds new offers and does not remove old ones. All offers are tailored to the villager type (a Farmer sells what a farmer would, and not, for example, diamonds). Most of the new offers are completely new, but some are modeled on offers from the "Bedrock Edition", e.g., a Farmer sells bottles of honey, or from newer versions, e.g., you can buy a "name tag" from villagers.

# Villagers with new offers:
- armorer
- librarian
- farmer
- cartographer

# Sample offers:
Farmer:
- Emeralds --> Bottles of honey
- Emeralds --> Bone meal
- Wheat seeds --> Emeralds

Librarian:
- Emeralds --> Book with a feather

Armorer:
- Emeralds --> Armor for a horse (two variants)
- Emeralds --> Golden armor (full set)

and other offers...

## Future versions:
- 1.20.1 forge - Unfortunately, I couldn't make the 1.20.1 Forge version, although that was the initial intention. If, however, I manage to fix it (unlikely), this version will appear here.
- 1.21.1 Neoforge
